name: Eternal Grasp lengthens Tentacle summon durations by 25% (#719)
contract: Eternal Grasp 704878 reads 'Increases the duration of your Tentacles by 25%.' In the installed Spell.dbc it is passive, family 31, effect 0 is SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER (108), misc 1 = SPELLMOD_DURATION, BasePoints 24 / DieSides 1 = +25%, class mask [32, 4194432, 536870912] = dword 0 bit 5, dword 1 bits 7 and 22, dword 2 bit 29 -- a deliberately wide mask covering every Old-God tentacle summon the Cultist can cast. Tentacle of N'Zoth 572103 (family 31) carries SpellFamilyFlags[0] 32 (bit 5, matches dword 0) and DurationIndex 31 (SpellDuration.dbc: 8000 ms, verified directly). Tentacle of Yogg-Saron 802042 carries SpellFamilyFlags[1] 128 (bit 7, matches dword 1) and DurationIndex 9 (SpellDuration.dbc: 30000 ms, verified directly). Player::ApplySpellMod (Player.cpp:10219-10323) computes SPELLMOD_DURATION as (base+totalflat)*totalmul (line 10323); with only the 25% PCT mod, 8000*1.25=10000 and 30000*1.25=37500. Grasp of Zek'voz 573028 (family 31, SpellFamilyFlags = [2,0,0]) shares none of the three mask words and is the control. The scenario probes the duration modifier on both tentacle spells' real base durations and does not summon them.

steps.label: SETUP: Tentacle of N'Zoth's real 8000 ms duration is unmodified
SETUP: Tentacle of Yogg-Saron's real 30000 ms duration is unmodified
Tentacle of N'Zoth's duration rises to 10000 ms (+25%, dword 0 bit 5)
Tentacle of Yogg-Saron's duration rises to 37500 ms (+25%, dword 1 bit 7)
Grasp of Zek'voz is outside the mask
Tentacle of N'Zoth returns to 8000 ms
